mentions.name: Trilogy Studio Core
mentions.description: An open-source alternative to Looker/Data Studio that supports BigQuery, Snowflake, and DuckDB. It features a custom SQL dialect with an embedded semantic layer that makes creating reusable and interactive visuals easier, and can be self-hosted or used via a public hosted version.
